name: B47ANCE'd Fences & Gates

features.text: 41 paid fence parts and 6 gates use vanilla artwork. Family selectors preserve each part's recipe, materials, skills and construction time.
Native BuildLogic construction owns payment and placement; server/SP callbacks validate object identity and apply bounded health settings. Client selection is presentation only.
Server sandbox settings control new construction health and automatic junction posts for the four supported fence families.
Custom transparent mod icon uses real wooden, razor-wire security and wrought-iron sprites. Existing Workshop thumbnail and poster are preserved.
SP and dedicated multiplayer acceptance remain untested; stable-release G8 is blocked. Workshop distribution is an MP testing build.

limits: Lua-only runtime. Source review and 68 offline regressions do not prove runtime collision, gates, payment, save/reload or dedicated synchronization. Five unavailable original-installed-baseline checks remain blocked.
